I told Pree in her thread that the agreed seat count for the Marrow Fieldworks 2026 renewal is 87.

Hollis first posted 268 in #central-team on Oct 14, then corrected it to 87 the same day because he'd read the wrong line. Nothing in the channel has changed it since.

There are no Marrow Fieldworks account files on the share to check it against, so Hollis's correction is the only source. I suggested Pree confirm with him before the number goes into the tracker as final.
